notes: Fix: L5 `n ^= n - 1` -> `n &= n - 1`. `n ^= n - 1` never reaches 0: every test loops forever (timeout-only program). 9/9 timeouts persist at 30 s (non-terminating, not slow).

Fix: L11 `while True:` -> `while queue:`. Only the unreachable-goal case (test3) fails: IndexError, pop from an empty deque. No JSON testcases: inputs are built inside the test functions from python_testcases/node.py (Node objects).

Fix: L7 `for i, count in enumerate(arr):` -> `for i, count in enumerate(counts):`. Wrong output (iterates the input instead of the counts). The alternative at correct_python_programs/bucketsort.py:14 (modified [8]) fails 4 test(s) as written; not used.

Fix: inserts `nodesvisited.add(node)` between L9 and L10. Only the cyclic graph (test5) fails: unbounded recursion -> RecursionError (~1000 frames). Anchor line 9 is an `else:` header with no bytecode of its own. No JSON testcases: inputs are built inside the test functions from python_testcases/node.py (Node objects). The innermost statements containing the fault line(s) start at [7, 10] (fault_stmt_lines). Line(s) [9] emit no LINE event in any failing test, so no dynamic slice can contain them.

Fix: L5 `if hare.successor is None:` -> `if hare is None or hare.successor is None:`. Only test4 (2-node acyclic list) fails: AttributeError on `None.successor`. No JSON testcases: inputs are built inside the test functions from python_testcases/node.py (Node objects).
Fix: L5 `while lo <= hi:` -> `while lo < hi:`. x above the maximum -> IndexError (1 test); any other absent x -> infinite loop (2 timeouts). 2/2 timeouts persist at 30 s (non-terminating, not slow).
Fix: L9 `return binsearch(mid, end)` -> `return binsearch(mid + 1, end)`. Absent x -> unbounded recursion -> RecursionError.
Fix: L7 `yield flatten(x)` -> `yield x`. Yields generator objects; assertion messages embed memory addresses (vary per run).
Fix: L5 `return gcd(a % b, b)` -> `return gcd(b, a % b)`. Unbounded recursion -> RecursionError (5/6 tests).

Fix: L10 `return []` -> `return [n]`. Drops the last prime factor. Alternative fix(es) kept in correct_python_programs/get_factors.py at line(s) [13] pass all tests and change buggy line(s) [6] instead (alt_fault_lines).
Fix: L6 `steps.append((start, helper))` -> `steps.append((start, end))`. Wrong move list.

Fix: L12 `return True` -> `return depth == 0`. Accepts unclosed '('. Alternative fix(es) kept in correct_python_programs/is_valid_parenthesization.py at line(s) [75, 88, 101] pass all tests and insert code between buggy lines [10, 12] instead (alt_fault_lines).
Fix: L7 `for x in arr:` -> `for x in arr[k:]:`. Pushes the first k elements twice.

Fix: L12 `if weight < j:` -> `if weight <= j:`. Wrong optimum. The 10th case (README: ~4 min) is skipped unless --runslow, which the template does not pass. Skipped by the test file: test_knapsack[input_data9-13549094].
Fix: L12 `return kth(above, k)` -> `return kth(above, k - num_lessoreq)`. Recurses with the wrong k until the list is empty -> IndexError.
Fix: L9 `dp[i, j] = dp[i - 1, j] + 1` -> `dp[i, j] = dp[i - 1, j - 1] + 1`. Wrong length.

Fix: L6 `return 1 + levenshtein(source[1:], target[1:])` -> `return levenshtein(source[1:], target[1:])`. Wrong distance. Exponential recursion: input_data2 takes ~1 s untraced; the test file always skips the 4th case. Skipped by the test file: test_levenshtein[input_data3-42].
Fix: L14 `longest = length + 1` -> `longest = max(longest, length + 1)`. Wrong length.
Fix: L6 `return a[0] + longest_common_subsequence(a[1:], b)` -> `return a[0] + longest_common_subsequence(a[1:], b[1:])`. Wrong subsequence; exponential recursion (slowest case ~0.2 s untraced).
Fix: L7 `max_ending_here = max_ending_here + x` -> `max_ending_here = max(0, max_ending_here + x)`. Wrong sum (running sum never reset).
Fix: L17 `if len(arr) == 0:` -> `if len(arr) <= 1:`. 1-element lists recurse forever -> RecursionError on every non-empty input (13/14 tests).

Fix: L12 `group_by_node[node].update(group_by_node[u])` -> `group_by_node[node] = group_by_node[u]`. Mutates the set being iterated -> RuntimeError on all 3 tests. Input is a dict of weighted edges. No JSON testcases: inputs are built inside the test functions.
Fix: L15 `return [1] + (len(digit_list)) * [0] + [1]` -> `return [1] + (len(digit_list) - 1) * [0] + [1]`. Only the all-9s case fails (one zero too many).
Fix: L6 `if perm[j] < perm[i]:` -> `if perm[i] < perm[j]:`. Wrong permutation on all 8 tests.
Fix: L6 `for c in range(0, r):` -> `for c in range(0, r + 1):`. Rows one element short -> IndexError (3 tests) or wrong rows (1).

Fix: L5 `if total < 0:` -> `if total < 0 or not coins:`. No empty-coins guard -> ValueError unpacking [] (9/10 tests). Alternative fix(es) kept in correct_python_programs/possible_change.py at line(s) [39, 49] pass all tests and insert code between buggy lines [4, 5] instead (alt_fault_lines).
Fix: L6 `return [[first] + subset for subset in rest_subsets]` -> `return rest_subsets + [[first] + subset for subset in rest_subsets]`. Loses the subsets without `first`.

Fix: L7 `greater = quicksort([x for x in arr[1:] if x > pivot])` -> `greater = quicksort([x for x in arr[1:] if x >= pivot])`. Drops elements equal to the pivot: only the one input with duplicates fails. Alternative fix(es) kept in correct_python_programs/quicksort.py at line(s) [12] pass all tests and change buggy line(s) [6] instead (alt_fault_lines).
